description: READ-ONLY: realized/closed-PnL history on a CEX connection (one row per closed position carrying net pnl + fees, for diary sync). Never moves funds. Rows whose venue reports no side stay null — side is never inferred from the PnL sign; Binance rows carry entryPrice 0 = unknown (the income feed has no entry price) and exitPrice is the paired closing fill when one was found.

connectionId.description: CEX connection id (see list_connections). Takes precedence over exchange.

exchange.description: CEX slug, e.g. kucoin (resolved to an active connection; connectionId wins when both are given)

name: read_closed_pnl
title: Read closed CEX PnL
